subject: Vendor enrollment: PO acceptance, VAT split / debit note question
messages:
From: Sofia Molina <sofia.molina@galileopay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment: PO fields and VAT handling question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for speaking with our vendor enablement team this morning. We're initiating Redwood Inference for Galileo's merchant payouts program and need to get Redwood registered in our AP portal so POs and payments flow cleanly. Before we start the portal onboarding, two quick clarifications so our AP team can prepare the enrollment packet: 

1) PO acknowledgement: our PO XML requires a vendor_tax_id and a legal_entity_name element. Will Redwood be able to produce those exact fields on your invoices?

2) VAT handling: for a subset of transactions Galileo needs to issue a debit note (reverse/invoice split) so we remain self-billing for merchant commissions. Will Redwood accept a debit note flow (Galileo issues a debit note to adjust net commission and we pay the net amount), or do you require standard vendor invoices for all flows?

I've attached a sample PO (Galileo_PO_sample-2028-06.pdf) and our AP onboarding checklist. If you can confirm the two items above and provide a preferred remit address and tax ID we'll start the portal invite.

Appreciate it —
Sofia Molina
Vendor Enablement Lead
Galileo Payments, Inc.

Attachment: Galileo_PO_sample-2028-06.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Molina <sofia.molina@galileopay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: PO fields and VAT handling question

Hi Sofia —

Thanks, and great to connect earlier. Short answers up front:
- PO fields: yes. We can include vendor_tax_id (TIN/EIN equivalent) and our full legal entity as separate fields in the invoice metadata and the UBL XML export. We maintain both a human-readable invoice header and a machine-friendly UBL/PEPPOL-like payload for portal integrations.
- VAT / debit note: Redwood can support a debit-note/self-billing arrangement for the specific commission flows you described, but we need 1) a short commercial agreement clause that references the debit-note mechanism, and 2) test invoice transaction(s) in your sandbox so we can validate accounting codes.

Remit and tax details below (please confirm which legal entity you should register):
- Legal entity (for Galileo registrations): Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 450 Townsend St., Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107
- US Tax ID: 94-324XXXX (EIN) — will provide full TIN in the portal (we redact in email)

I've attached our vendor payload spreadsheet (Redwood_vendor_payload_20280614.xlsx) with sample UBL fields and the invoice template we prefer (PDF + XML attachment). For the debit-note flow we typically do: Galileo issues a debit note referencing the original PO and merchant settlement ID; Redwood issues a matching acknowledgment invoice (zero or adjusted amount) to provide a clear audit trail. Ben (cc'ed) is our Finance lead and will coordinate tax evidence if you need VAT registration documents for EU flows.

Next steps we suggest: 
1) Send the portal invite to vendor-admin@redwoodinference.com (we'll accept the invite and populate entity fields).
2) Add a test PO (PO_TEST_0001) and a debit-note test in sandbox so we can validate mapping.
3) Sign a short addendum for debit-note self-billing (we can draft).

Happy to hop on a 30m if that helps.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_vendor_payload_20280614.xlsx)
From: Sofia Molina <sofia.molina@galileopay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ricardo Alvarez <ricardo.alvarez@galileopay.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: PO fields and VAT handling question

Rachel —

Great, that's helpful. A few follow-ups from our AP and tax teams after reviewing your payload sheet: 

• Our PO schema will include two VAT-related nodes when applicable: vat_rate and vat_responsibility (payer|receiver). For self-billing/debit note flows we set vat_responsibility to payer=Galileo and attach a debit_note XML that reduces the gross commission. Can your UBL payload include vat_responsibility and a debit_note reference element?

• For audit purposes we need a copy of your standard invoice acceptance SLA — specifically the acceptance window (we typically require 14 days to raise disputes). Can you confirm Redwood's acceptance window and any auto-accept rules?

• Our tax team asks for: VAT registration certificate (for EU cross-border flows), and the W-9 (for US entity). If Redwood prefers to share via secure link in portal that works.

I've uploaded a sample test PO and a sandbox debit note to the drive (link below). Can you pick a day early next week for the test run? If the tests pass we'll push the production portal invite and acceptance rules.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example

Best,
Sofia

Attachment: Galileo_PO_sample-2028-06.pdf (re-attached)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Molina <sofia.molina@galileopay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: PO fields and VAT handling question

Sofia —

Thanks for the quick follow-ups and the test artifacts. Confirmations below (and copying Ben and Marissa for finance/ops coordination):

• vat_responsibility and debit_note reference: yes. Our UBL and XML attachments can include a custom vat_responsibility tag and a debit_note_reference tag that points to the Galileo debit note ID. We'll include a mapping table in the payload sheet (see updated column notes).

• Invoice acceptance SLA: Redwood standard is 21 days from receipt for dispute/acceptance; after 21 days invoices are auto-marked accepted unless a formal dispute is opened with supporting evidence. If Galileo needs a 14-day SLA we can accept that for this engagement — we'll note it in the onboarding addendum.

• Documents: W-9 and a copy of our VAT registration (Redwood EU branch) will be uploaded to the portal during the enrollment flow. We prefer secure portal delivery rather than open email.

Proposed test schedule:
- Mon 2028-06-19 09:00 PT: sandbox PO_TEST_0001 (Galileo -> Redwood)
- Mon 2028-06-19 09:15 PT: sandbox debit note DN_TEST_0001 referencing PO_TEST_0001
- Outcomes: Redwood to respond with invoice ack + payload and a matching XML debit_note_reference mapping within 30 minutes of the sandbox events.

Marissa, Ben — can you confirm Finance will be available for the test window and that the portal invite should go to vendor-admin@redwoodinference.com? Also, we'll need the portal user to have file upload rights for certs.

If everyone is aligned I'll (1) sign the short addendum draft and (2) accept the portal invite when it lands.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the onboarding flow.

Rachel Kim
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
